title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 12
desc: Ruhaani from Mumbai travels to Delhi to meet Chirag’s family—who also happens to be her boyfriend. As she navigates the warmth and chaos of Delhi's culture, she uncovers surprising truths about his family, their expectations, and where she truly stands in his life.

title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 13
desc: In Episode 13, Ruhani’s lavish surprise for Chirag collides with his secret plan to move back to Delhi for his mother and a major opportunity, leading to an emotional confrontation that tests their love and leaves both with a bittersweet, unsent goodbye.

title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 14
desc: In the gripping final episode of Delhi vs Mumbai, emotions run high as Chirag (Abhishek Kapoor) and Ruhani (Malhaar Rathod) face the ultimate test of love. With tough decisions about career, family, and their future together, will distance and city-based differences pull them apart — or will love triumph over all?

title: Emergency Room Ep 01
desc: In a busy hospital, Trisha faces a tough night when an accident victim is rushed into the emergency ward. As she works to save his life, the victim’s panicked father lashes out at her, demanding faster treatment. But Trisha stays calm, knowing that fear often comes out as anger.

title: Emergency Room Ep 02
desc: Trisha steps up when it matters most. When a man begins to choke and the situation turns critical, Trisha doesn’t hesitate. With calm precision and unmatched courage, she performs a high-stakes procedure all on her own. What happens next is nothing short of remarkable. Her quick thinking and skill become the difference between life and death. Watch how one nurse turns pressure into action.

title: Emergency Room Ep 03
desc: Trisha decides to take a long leave from the hospital to spend much-needed time with her family. Just as she steps away, the hospital is hit with a major emergency. Without hesitation, Trisha returns to duty, putting others before herself and becoming a true hero in a time of crisis. Watch this heartfelt story of courage, sacrifice, and the dilemma between duty and family.
